tasks.title: Stall speed from mass and wing
tasks.solution: V_s = √(2·m·g / (ρ·S·C_Lmax)). The module example: 4.5 kg, 0.75 m², 1.2 → 8.95 m/s. Then, by the module's rules: FW_AIRSPD_STALL = V_s, FW_AIRSPD_MIN = 1.25·V_s (rounded up to 0.5).

tasks.title: Minimum airspeed in a turn
tasks.solution: PerformanceModel::getMinimumCalibratedAirspeed: MIN·√n, n = 1/cos φ. At 50° n = 1.556, √n = 1.247: 11.5 → 14.34 m/s. The stall speed in a turn grows the same way.

tasks.title: Back transition start distance
tasks.solution: mission_block.cpp: the waypoint acceptance radius = v²/(2·VT_B_DEC_MSS). 16 m/s and 2 m/s² → 64 m. By the code the transition ends earlier, at MPC_XY_CRUISE (5 m/s), after (v² − 25)/(2a) meters.

tasks.title: Front transition time
tasks.solution: isFrontTransitionCompletedBase: both conditions are needed, time > VT_TRANS_MIN_TM and V ≥ VT_ARSP_TRANS. Reaching the airspeed takes vt/acc, so the result is max(VT_TRANS_MIN_TM, vt/acc). Check separately that VT_ARSP_BLEND is reached before VT_F_TR_OL_TM; otherwise you get a quad-chute.

tasks.title: Transition timeout at altitude
tasks.solution: getFrontTransitionTimeFactor: the factor is (ρ₀/ρ)^1.5, with ρ limited to 0.7…1.5 kg/m³. At ρ = 1.0 the factor is 1.356: 15 s → 20.3 s. VT_TRANS_MIN_TM and VT_F_TR_OL_TM get the same factor.
